items.question: Which platforms do you use?
items.answer: We work with HubSpot, ActiveCampaign, Mailchimp, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Marketo, and more—chosen for your case.

items.question: Do I need to change my CRM?
items.answer: Not necessarily. We integrate automation with your existing CRM when feasible to minimize change.

items.question: When will we see results?
items.answer: Time savings and nurtured leads start month one. Conversion lift usually shows in months 2-3 once data is in.

items.question: How do you avoid spam?
items.answer: SPF/DKIM/DMARC setup, domain warmup, segmentation, list hygiene, and continuous monitoring.

items.question: Can you automate beyond email?
items.answer: Yes—lead routing, internal alerts, SMS, WhatsApp, chatbots, tasks, and more.

items.question: What if my team isn't technical?
